name: Editoria11y si (SiteImprove)
description: Pulls in quality assurance data from SiteImprove and leverages editoria11y interface to display issues.
project_description:
The editoria11y_si module integrates with SiteImprove (subscription required) and displays broken links using the editoria11y UI (drupal module).

 Features 
 The primary use case for this module is:

 
 Show broken links to content authors using the editoria11y UI 
 Show a report broken links in an admin view 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Create an Editoria11y SI key at /admin/config/system/keys with values of:
 
 username 
 api_key 
 site 
 group (optional) 
 
 
 Select key at /admin/config/content/editoria11y/si 
 Create cronjob by running: drush ev "editoria11y_si_queue_cronjob();" 
 Export config (editoria11y.settings's custom_tests gets incremented by 1) 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Editoria11y drupal module 
 Key drupal module 
 SiteImprove subscription with API key
